definitions.configuration: HOME field players v AWAY field players / HOME goalkeeper count v AWAY goalkeeper count. Actual total bodies are also explicit. A legal keeper removal may equalize field counts while leaving fewer total bodies and an empty goal.
definitions.duration: Intervals between already recorded actual court-population boundaries; official and simulation time separate.
definitions.events: Post-tick unit configuration. Field goals/attempts both use shot-release configuration. Counts and field conversion pool both teams within the HOME v AWAY configuration; they are not power-play efficiency estimates for just the attacking side.
definitions.possessions: Existing canonical possessionEconomy episode keys and aliases, never a new definition. Starts/mean attack duration stratify by starting configuration; losses by terminal configuration. A changing unit does not create a new possession.
definitions.sampling: Before40+40 and targeted after8+8 are distinct designs. Live option/width/coverage samples are from the two current production proof sessions.
